description: This file defines the GatewayEndpointStore actor responsible for managing and resolving the gateway control endpoint configuration and state, including remote tunnel management, configuration resolution, and URL construction. It handles internal state, external dependencies, and provides observable streams for state changes.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: An actor that manages the gateway control endpoint state, configuration, and remote tunnel ensuring actions.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of GatewayEndpointState updates, with optional buffering.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current mode and state asynchronously.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode (local, remote, unconfigured) and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures the remote control tunnel is established and returns the control port.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Returns current gateway configuration, waiting for setup if necessary.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Attempts to fallback to tailnet IP if current URL is localhost and certain conditions are met.
